prompt:

Title: 3d Digital Product Mock-up in Blender
I have this mockup from ChatGPT and I want a scene in Blender that looks exactly like this, box-shaped object with a nice slit close to the edge. I want the final product to be a Blender file with the scene rigged and nice lighting so I can instantly export the scene as an image.You don't have to design the actual cover of the product, but please deliver the product with some cover so I can see how it looks like in the render, and I need instructions for how I can easily change the texture/cover to my own.The idea is to have a scene where I can write a Python script to generate 100s of these product renderings but with different textures on the model. text:
I’m a passionate, hard-working freelancer with extensive experience in Python and machine learning, and I’d love to help build this Blender product mockup scene.

In a recent project, Product recommendations for Tidewater Outfitters, I built similar-items and you-may-also-like carousels trained on 1.2M interactions, with Redis caching; it led to a 14% click-through rate lift in a 4-week A/B test.

For your Blender file, I can help structure the scene so the product is easy to render, light, and reusable for batch generation. I can also make sure the texture/cover is easy to swap, and I’ll include instructions so you can change the text or texture yourself for hundreds of variants.

Would you like the product text set up as editable mesh text or as a texture-based design for easier batch rendering?
